title: Head injury
scenario: Hit on the head by falling object or during a fall. Dizzy, confused, headache, vision blurry, bump or bleeding on the scalp.
steps: Have the person sit or lie down and keep still.
Press a clean cloth gently on any scalp bleeding.
Apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth to the bump.
Seek medical help — head injuries can worsen hours later.
Watch for worsening symptoms: repeated vomiting, growing confusion, unequal pupils, slurred speech, seizure, clear fluid from nose or ears, or hard to wake. Any of these: call 911.
Keep checking on them for the next 24 hours, including waking them periodically if they sleep.
do_not: Do not leave a person with a significant head injury alone.
Do not give alcohol or sedatives.
Do not assume sleep will fix it — keep checking on them.
